## AI writes product and collection descriptions, then publishes them to your store instantly. 

 Descrii writes product and collection descriptions, titles, and SEO content using AI, then publishes them directly to your store. Select one item or many at once for bulk generation. Merchants can set a brand voice once so every description matches their store's tone automatically, choose whether AI updates titles or only descriptions, and turn on automatic generation for new products as they're added. Built for stores with large catalogs or frequent new product launches.
